output.scope_note: The paper is a computational MD method (OnsagerDecomposer) applied to LATP, PEO/PPM polymers and liquid electrolytes, but it gives no numeric ionic conductivity for any solid Li conductor in the text; the solid-state sigma_NE values appear only in figures, and the only numeric conductivities (40.3 and 11.9 mS/cm) are for a liquid electrolyte.
